package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	name := filepath.Base(os.Args[0])
	path := filepath.Join(os.Getenv("GOLAW_M2_RECORDERS"), name+".started")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(name+"\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(98)
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "forbidden rung executable started:", name)
	os.Exit(97)
}
